inputs.label: The House of the Dead arcade ROM set (MAME 0.289)
inputs.help: Your own MAME 0.289 set hotd.zip. Leave it zipped.

steps.why: The app searches all storage for the ROM sets. The guide has the user allow this in the headset.

steps.text: Open Port0r: House of the Dead VR from Library > Unknown Sources. If it asks for All files access, allow it. The game copies the ROM set in and starts; until then, a setup screen lists any missing files.

notes: port0r holds every Port0r game in one repository; tag selects House of the Dead VR. A future hotd2 tag prefix would not match ^hotd-v. Granting the appop over adb is not yet tested on a Quest.
